messages:
Ivy: dropping a short thread about preview suppression guardrails. sketch: tiny toggle on channel row to stop preview deliveries while iterating on templates. figma: https://figma.redwood/preview-guardrails
Rafael: per-channel default = session-only. sticky persist should be opt-in. backend needs a `preview_suppressed` flag on route config.
Jo: copy nit: replace 'mute' with 'Don't deliver preview' or 'Silence preview delivery' to avoid confusion with audio.
Kim: accessibility: add aria-label 'Don't deliver preview for #channel' and announce via live region when toggled. ensure contrast for muted state in dark theme.
Ivy: behavioral ACs: 1) suppressed previews must still emit audit events; 2) suppression shouldn't change routing or transforms; 3) canary/test sends should bypass suppression only if user explicitly picks 'Send test'.
Rafael: telemetry: preview.suppression.toggled {channel_id,user_id,persist}. debounce client toggles to reduce noise. API example: PATCH /v1/routes/:id {"preview_suppressed":true}
Jo: keyboard flow: toggle must be reachable in tab order and activatable by Space/Enter; expose aria-pressed. add tooltip: 'Previews will not be delivered to this channel.'
a11y-bot: reminder: visible focus ring, role=status announcement, and provide non-color indicator for suppressed state.
Ivy: I'll update Figma with high-contrast token and add the one-time confirmation copy: 'Stop delivering previews to this channel? [Don't show again]'. posting updated frames soon.
Rafael: I'll add the feature flag preview_suppression.v1 and add server-side audit emission. tagging @Jo for acceptance criteria in the ticket.
Jo: added ACs to ALERT-9001: persistence rules, audit logs, keyboard + screen reader flows. closing loop.
